# glinet_multiwan_status (Data Source)

Get the state of the multi-WAN interfaces (`kmwan.get_status`). The web UI shows the IPv4 status for track protocol `ipv4`, the IPv6 status for `ipv6`, and both for `both` or when tracking is disabled. The values change while the router runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_multiwan_status" "this" {}

output "multiwan_ipv4_status" {
  value = { for i in data.glinet_multiwan_status.this.interfaces : i.interface => i.ipv4_status }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Multi-WAN interfaces of the router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface, for example `wan` or `wwan`.
- `ipv4_status` (String) IPv4 status of the interface: `online`, `offline` or `error` (`status_v4` `0`, `1` or `2` in the router API). Null for a value that the web UI does not know.
- `ipv6_status` (String) IPv6 status of the interface: `online`, `offline` or `error` (`status_v6` `0`, `1` or `2` in the router API). Null for a value that the web UI does not know.
